item.text: I found a very small Next.js app; next I’m reading `app/page.tsx`, `app/product/page.tsx`, and `lib/data.ts` to locate what’s delaying the product title render.

I confirmed the bottleneck: `app/product/page.tsx` waits on `getInventory()` before rendering anything, so the `<h1>` is blocked. I’m editing the page to render the title immediately and load inventory inside a `Suspense` boundary.
The rendering path is now split so only inventory waits on the server. I’m running a build check to verify this compiles and streams correctly.

Updated the product route to render the title immediately by deferring inventory fetch behind `Suspense`. - Changed [app/product/page.tsx](/vercel/sandbox/app/product/page.tsx:1) so `ProductPage` is synchronous and renders `

` right away. - Moved `await getInventory()` into an async child component (`InventoryDetails`). - Wrapped that child in `Loading inventory...

}>` so inventory/price load after initial UI. Validation: - `npm run build` passes. - Build marks `/product` as partial prerendered (`◐`), which is the expected streaming behavior for immediate title paint.
